metadata.purpose: Verify the current AIMayaTool foundation before any Maya runtime work. This is the first project-worker task and intentionally uses only inherited AIBrigde verification/Git capabilities.
acceptance: Compile every current Python source file in bootstrap.py and aimayatool/.
Run import smoke for Python-only package entry points that do not require Maya.
Report exact main commit, interpreter, changed/failing file if any, and concise stdout/stderr evidence.
Do not launch Maya and do not mutate scenes.

metadata.purpose: Read-only discovery of locally available Maya/mayapy executables and versions so Maya-specific routes can bind to real owner-machine evidence instead of hard-coded paths.
acceptance: Do not install or modify Maya.
Return discovered Maya versions and executable paths relevant to mayapy or batch validation.
Do not launch an interactive scene and do not mutate user files.
If the required generic discovery route is not yet available, report ROUTE_MISSING without substituting an unrelated route.

metadata.purpose: Validate the current bootstrap and main UI shell in a bounded Maya runtime after deterministic verification and runtime discovery pass.
acceptance: Launch/import AIMayaTool through the supported bootstrap path in an isolated Maya validation context.
Confirm exactly one AIMayaTool window can be created and re-running bootstrap remains idempotent.
Confirm Skinning, Setup, and Scene sections construct without traceback.
Return Maya version, exact repository commit, stdout/stderr/traceback evidence, and cleanup outcome.
Do not save or modify production scenes.
